learning_extracted: SD-076's use_waking_confidence_inflation has NO USABLE HEADROOM: rv_final = exactly 0.010000 on all four inflation arms and overconfidence_score is bit-identical at LO and HI to 15 significant figures. Two candidate causes, both implementation-side: (a) the clamp on running_variance sits at or below the operating point, or (b) the inflation has the wrong sign (the precondition is inflation_lowers_rv and rv rose to the bound).

A bit-identical DV across two nominally different doses is a SATURATION FINGERPRINT and should be a standing lint: two dose levels producing the same value beyond float noise cannot be a null. Cheap to detect automatically. Related to but distinct from the existing inert_arm_knob lint (ree-v3 c040d28), which catches a declared-distinct arm pair that RAN identically -- here the arms ran with different knobs and produced identical output.

The V3-EXQ-785 per-arm gate pattern earned its keep: because the red arms were gated out rather than allowed to vacate the green ones, ARM_OFF_OFF and ARM_BCAST_ONLY stayed scored and C4 could confirm the 774 ceiling reproduces at -0.192. Without it the whole run would have read precondition_unmet and that confirmation would have been lost.
The Phase-7 write-site correction (E3-score space -> precision space, escaping the V3-EXQ-604c DV-invariance class) was RIGHT and is untouched by this failure. Only the drift source needs repair.
Recording debt: none. per_arm_gate, criteria_non_degenerate, aggregates.arm_rv_final and the LO/HI contrast were all recorded and are what made this adjudicable without a re-run.
